rationale: The agent did not meet policy requirements. While they looked up the user and orders, there’s no evidence of proper user authentication. They performed a write action (return_delivered_order_items for #W5490111) without explicit user confirmation, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. They also attempted to direct the refund to a different payment method, which contradicts the stated system limitation (refunds only to the original method or a gift card). Additionally, they did not process returns for both orders—only one return call is shown, leaving #W7387996 unaddressed. Although the agent ultimately handed off to a human and conveyed the system limitation correctly, the premature and noncompliant write and incomplete fulfillment cause the overall outcome to fail.
